correctness.rationale: For all n>=3 positive pi and prices, generator Poisson equations telescope to H_(i,i+1)=P_i/w_i and H_(i+1,i)=(1-P_i)/w_i; strong Markov telescoping gives the global ordered-pair maximum exactly at endpoints. For each lambda in [0,1], Cauchy–Schwarz yields the S(lambda)^2 bound with a unique positive equality conductance vector. S is strictly concave since G'<0 when the P_i cannot all equal 1/2. At its unique maximizer lambda*, derivative = forward minus backward endpoint hitting time; the interior-zero or appropriate boundary derivative sign ensures the max equals S(lambda*)^2. Cauchy equality implies unique global optimizer. Direct algebra proves mass-cancellation and the three-state price thresholds. The extracted finite checker completed 220 exact rational Poisson solves and 800 optimized design comparisons; these support but do not establish the universal proof.

originality.rationale: The closest full papers establish given-chain hitting-time identities (Palacios–Gómez–Del Río 2014; Palacios–Quiroz 2016), and conductance design for total/maximum symmetric effective resistance (Ghosh–Boyd–Saberi 2006/2008). Those premises do not imply the optimum of the maximum of two *directed* endpoint hitting-time functionals with prescribed externally fixed stationary masses and arbitrary prices, its unique scalar multiplier, mass-cancellation invariance or exact three-state price frontier. Separate reviewed path spectral-gap optimization targets a different functional. The closest relevant research-record ID studies a fixed quarter-grid 8-state discrete chain and maximization, not the present minimax resource allocation. Residual uncertainty remains concerning the uninspected full text of Palacios–Tetali (1996) and unknown equivalent historical specializations.
residual_risks: The 1996 Palacios–Tetali paper could not be inspected beyond its abstract and references, so its entire contents are not cleared. The inspected later fixed-hitting-time formulas reduce but do not remove this uncertainty.
Equivalent specialized network-design results in uncatalogued historical optimization literature could exist; semantic and keyword search failures do not prove global novelty.
Aldous–Fill was inspected by relevant sections, not all 516 pages; related formulations in unread chapters remain a historical risk.
The accessible 2006 Ghosh conference version predates the 2008 online journal, but the exact first-public day of the conference manuscript remains unverified.

value.rationale: Worst directed expected hitting time is a natural robust communication/transport latency objective. All arbitrary path sizes, positive stationary laws and independently priced edges are classified, with exact unique optimal rates and a scalar monotone-root computation rather than general multi-variable SDP. The stationary-mass cancellation condition reveals a substantial invariant family, and the exact three-state threefold-price interval identifies a meaningful complete phase boundary. The result is not a fixed-table recomputation, a routine subsumed corollary of total effective resistance, or a mere renaming of a spectral-gap optimization. Its value is restricted to this precise robustness objective; no arbitrary-graph or downstream mixing-time claim is asserted.
